description_en: This operation publishes a layer version
name: CreateLayerVersion

parameters.description_en:
The code configurations of the function. Code packages can be provided in the following methods:

1.  Include content of a code package in requests. In this case, zipFile must be set.
2.  Upload a code package to Object Storage Service (OSS). Include the path of the OSS object in requests. In this case, you must set ossBucketName and ossObjectName.
parameters.description_zh:
函数代码配置。可以使用两种方式提供代码包：
1. 直接将代码包的内容包含在请求中，此时zipFile必须设置。
2. 将代码包上传到OSS，在请求中包含OSS文件的地址，此时ossBucketName和ossObjectName必须设置。

fields.description_en: The CRC-64 value of the function code package. If checksum is provided, Function Compute checks whether the checksum of the code package is the same as that provided.
